_comment: Copy to /etc/dbaops-api/config.json. Secrets belong in dbaops.env, never here.
_target_policy: Replace these examples with the narrowest approved hostnames/CIDRs. At least one host or CIDR is required.
_trusted_proxy_cidrs: Replace with BIG-IP self/SNAT addresses before enabling TLS offload and X-Forwarded-Proto.
_allow_insecure_http: VIP 10.17.34.78:80 is plaintext, so this must be true for that mapping. Prefer BIG-IP TLS on :443, then set false.
